description: This file defines an extension on the Flutter ColorScheme to provide quick access to Ocean-themed tint colors such as primaryTint, secondaryTint, and tertiaryTint.

methods.name: primaryTint
methods.description: Returns the primary color with a subtle tint, achieved by setting alpha to 26.

methods.name: secondaryTint
methods.description: Returns the secondary color with a subtle tint, achieved by setting alpha to 26.

methods.name: tertiaryTint
methods.description: Returns the tertiary color with a subtle tint, achieved by setting alpha to 26.
